properties.name: The derived-relation check starts from populations the declarations do not choose — everything the code reaches, every function in the crate that names an edge, and each rule's own composition — and five declarations are corrected
properties.rationale: THE CAUSE (fact:root-cause-the-derived-declaration-check-draws-every-population-from-the-declarations-it-checks-2026-09-29, recorded in the live design): #631's check held each declaration only to what the declaration named — its functions (one self. call deep, blind to const tables and schema selectors), its edge list, and its own components — so it could find disagreement only INSIDE what was declared, and 13 declarations had been padded to pass it. Found by graph-primitives' monitoring pass 3 (fact:monitoring-pass-3-reflow2-pr-631-2026-09-29, a Python copy of the scanner), re-measured in Rust here: the monitor's HAS_READINESS, budget_rollup and arrival_delta findings held; its copy shared the scanner's blind spots and missed impact's 17 undeclared edges. WHY THIS REMOVES THE CAUSE: each check now starts from a population the declarations do not choose — the code's reach, the crate's edge-naming functions, the rule's text. WHAT IT CANNOT DO: check that a rule computes what the code computes (needs the planned rule engine); decide whether a function derives a relation (a judgement, so the population is ratcheted, not classified). PINNED, observed failing on a clean origin/main 87f17ec, under the shared build lock, with only the new tests, the composition_primitives helper and the ledger applied: 4 of 11 tests in derived_relations_are_declared_and_checked.rs failed. The reach check found 31 problems, among them 'readiness_gate: readiness.rs::readiness_report → resolve_gate → best_measured_level reads HAS_READINESS', forecast_readiness named as the gate's code while taking &mut self, impact's 17 undeclared edges, and budget_rollup's and arrival_delta's missing `over`. The population check found 5 mismatches from the misdeclared writer (and 135 unanswered functions with no list). The components check named 14 declarations and the stated-edge check 9 edges. every_edge_type_declares_what_it_means.rs, now also holding components to composition, passed 5/5 there: regression cover, not failing-first. The scanner's own net (two synthetic tests) covers a read two calls deep, a read through a const, a call across files, a writer the walk never enters, a test module ignored, and an unanswered reader named.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: crates/reflow2-core/tests/derived_relations_are_declared_and_checked.rs: (1) a transitive walk from every declared function — self./Self::/Type::/free/module-path calls, any depth, never entering a writer (&mut self) — holding every edge it reaches (named directly, through a const/static table, or through Schema::inference_edge_types) to the declaration and its `over`, and failing when a dedicated function reaches another relation's own code that `over` does not name, or when a declared site is a writer; (2) a population check: every function in reflow2-core/src naming an edge type is answered for by a declaration or listed, with its edges, in the new schema/derived/edge_readers.yaml (140 entries: 132 `unjudged`, a count that may only shrink, and 8 judged `not_derived`); (3) `components` must be exactly Reading::composition_primitives (new, foundation/core/schema.rs) — also asserted for every composite EDGE reading — and a declared edge the rule does not state must be named in not_yet_stated. schema/derived/relations.yaml corrected: readiness_gate (HAS_READINESS added; forecast_readiness, a writer, dropped; the composition states the forecast), impact (the twelve inference-module edges and the five RISK_EDGES added), budget_rollup (over: [discontinued]), arrival_delta (over: [delivered, realized, checked]), and 14 components lists, with compositions completed where the rule read an edge they did not state.
